groups.title: AWE Base Properties
groups.intro: These are the base application configuration properties for AWE projects. They have the prefix `awe.application`.

groups.title: AWE Database Properties
groups.intro: These are the database configuration properties for AWE projects. They have the prefix `awe.database`.

groups.title: AWE Datasource Pool Properties
groups.intro: AWE builds a connection pool for every database connection it loads (multidatabase). These are the Hikari pool settings it applies to all of them, under the Spring `spring.datasource` prefix. They do not apply to JNDI datasources.

groups.title: AWE Maintain Properties
groups.intro: These are the maintain configuration properties for AWE projects. They have the prefix `awe.maintain`. The multiple-maintain validation mode applies only to SQL-backed multiple maintain targets; service-delegated (`serve`), queue and email maintains are not affected.

groups.title: AWE Security Properties
groups.intro: These are all security configuration properties for AWE projects. They have the prefix `awe.security`.

groups.title: AWE Numeric Properties
groups.intro: These are the numeric configuration properties for AWE projects. They have the prefix `awe.numeric`.

groups.title: AWE Session Properties
groups.intro: These are the session configuration properties for AWE projects. They have the prefix `awe.session`.

groups.title: AWE Email Properties
groups.intro: These are the Email engine configuration properties for AWE projects. They have the prefix `awe.mail`.

groups.title: AWE Developer Properties
groups.intro: These are the Developer module configuration properties for AWE projects. They have the prefix `awe.developer`.

groups.title: AWE Rest Properties
groups.intro: These are the REST connector and Microservice connector configuration properties for AWE projects. They have the prefix `awe.rest`.

groups.title: AWE Scheduler Properties
groups.intro: These are the Scheduler module configuration properties for AWE projects. They have the prefix `awe.scheduler`.

groups.title: AWE Websocket Properties
groups.intro: These are the Websocket STOMP configuration properties for AWE projects. They have the prefix `awe.websocket`.

groups.title: AWE Notifier Properties
groups.intro: These are the Notifier module configuration properties for AWE projects. They have the prefix `awe.notifier`.

groups.title: AWE Test Properties
groups.intro: These are the configuration properties of the AWE testing module (`awe-testing`), used by the Selenium and Playwright integration tests. They have the prefix `awe.test`.
